description: With mode 'mirror', compares caller-supplied canonical and mirror records for missing, extra or changed data. With mode 'review-stamps', compares before and after snapshots for date changes with no visible evidence of a recheck. A changed value, source or reviewer can count as evidence even if no one reviewed anything. List automatic edits in ignoreFields. The stamp audit does not flag value changes by themselves. The kit cannot tell which copy is right, whether its data is true or current, or whether a recheck took place. Look-alike key detection covers only a limited set of characters. Supply JSON data directly. For record 'a' with a canonical price of 10, a mirror price of 10 yields 'ok' and a mirror price of 25 yields 'flagged'. Moving reviewedOn from '2026-01-01' to '2026-01-02' while price stays 10 is flagged as stamp-only. If price changes to 11 with the date, the same audit reports 'ok'.

allowEmpty.description: Allow an empty canonical set or snapshot. Default false.

fields.description: Fields to compare. Default all fields.

foldCase.description: Fold case when looking for look-alike keys. Default true.

foldInvisible.description: Ignore invisible characters when looking for look-alike keys. Default true.

ignoreFields.description: Fields to leave out. Unknown field names are reported.

key.description: Field that identifies a record. Default id.

numberTolerance.description: Absolute tolerance for numeric fields. Default 0.

reviewedField.description: Review-date field used to detect an unchanged stamp hiding drift.

allowEmpty.description: Allow an empty canonical set or snapshot. Default false.

bulkThreshold.description: Flag more than this many bumps to one UTC day. Default 10.

expiryField.description: Field containing an expiry or next-review date.

foldCase.description: Fold case when looking for look-alike keys. Default true.

foldInvisible.description: Ignore invisible characters when looking for look-alike keys. Default true.

ignoreFields.description: Fields to leave out. Unknown field names are reported.

key.description: Field that identifies a record. Default id.

now.description: Explicit zoned timestamp or epoch milliseconds. Omit to skip future-date checks.

sourceFields.description: Source fields. Pass [] if there are none.

valueFields.description: Fields that count as values when looking for a change.

name: check_parity
title: Compare a mirror or audit review stamps
